explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with next_token(), appending decoded plaintext only from #text tokens and from TITLE/TEXTAREA opener tokens via get_modifiable_text(); script/style content is naturally excluded because it is not ordinary #text. I truncated the final UTF-8 string by Unicode code points with mb_strlen()/mb_substr(), with a regex fallback if mbstring is unavailable.
